description: Scored US public sector briefs from official government data: product safety recalls (CPSC consumer products, NHTSA vehicles and equipment, FDA food), political money (FEC independent expenditures, Senate lobbying registrations and filings) and federal spending (USAspending award obligations by agency, Monthly Treasury Statement outlays, receipts and deficit). Each brief is a 0-100 score with label, trend versus the horizon, the inputs that drive it, risk flags, confidence and a citation for every input. POST /v1/brief {vertical} returns one scored brief; POST /v1/overview returns every brief at once; POST /v1/verticals lists them. Verticals: product-recalls (Are consumer product, vehicle or food recalls rising?); political-money (Is outside election spending or lobbying activity rising?); federal-spending (Is federal spending accelerating, and in which agencies?). Raw scored series: /v1/signals, /v1/signal, /v1/explain, /v1/catalog. Every response is a single JSON object. Research signal, not investment advice.

rpc_types.notes: POST /v1/verticals, POST /v1/brief, POST /v1/overview, POST /v1/signals, POST /v1/signal, POST /v1/explain, POST /v1/catalog; GET /v1/version, /v1/health. JSON body only. Bad input returns 400 + JSON.

serving.backend: Node.js HTTP server (zero npm dependencies) behind a RelayMiner at http://<container>:8080. No caller auth. Answers come from a private hub refreshed by a scheduled collector of official public data; 5-minute cache.
serving.notes: Gateway operators: configure as type passthrough with rpc_types ["rest"].
